arguments.sql: SELECT AVG(amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS avg_amount_usd, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions
arguments.explanation: Returns the average transaction amount in dollars across every transaction in the data, with the number of transactions it covers.
assumptions: Includes all transactions, including the ones with negative amounts. What those negative amounts mean isn't documented.
Includes transactions with and without a fraud label, and with or without an error.
Covers the whole data period, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
